---
title: "Application catalog"
subtitle: "Index by category, concept and data source"
description: "Applications on posterior ranking, common grade reports, and multidomain profiles."
---

Use the filters together to find applications by topic and data source. For example, the school cases use chronic
absence data, while the uncertainty examples often use simulated data. Search includes page titles, descriptions,
and preset names. In **Multiple criteria**, the common-grade applications use a shared grade column and the
profile applications give each domain its own column. Each entry links to the full page and a standalone app.
